title: Plynth project settings, version 6
description: The project.json file in a project folder. Lengths are in metres. Older files are upgraded when read: version 1 (project.v1.schema.json) gets defaults with the built-in sizes, version 2 (project.v2.schema.json) gets wall_item_centre 1.2, version 3 (project.v3.schema.json) gets materials with the built-in defaults, version 4 (project.v4.schema.json) gets the roof, flat_roof and stair materials, version 5 (project.v5.schema.json) gets the trim and railing materials and trim and variation with their defaults.

export_mode.description: single gives one FBX for the whole building, grouped gives one FBX per group.

defaults.description: Sizes new marks get. Marks already placed keep their own sizes. A door or a window (sill plus height) is never taller than ceiling_height, and wall_item_centre is below it.

ceiling_height.description: Ceiling height for floors made later. Each floor keeps its own ceiling_height in plan.json.

door_width.description: Width of new doors and plain openings.

door_height.description: Height of new doors and plain openings, from the floor.

window_sill.description: Height of the bottom of new windows above the floor.

wall_item_centre.description: Height above the floor of the centre of an item when it is first mounted on a wall, for example a TV.

materials.description: The material each kind of surface gets where plan.json names none: ids in the materials catalog, or null for the neutral look. The built-in defaults are the sample materials in samples/materials/. A missing field takes its default.

wall_inside.description: Wall faces that look into a room.

wall_outside.description: Wall faces that look into no room.

roof.description: The covering of pitched roofs: gable, hip, shed and sawtooth.

stair.description: Steps, landings and the column of a spiral stair.

trim.description: Skirting boards, cornices, casings and sills.

How each kind of trim is made. A missing field takes its default: skirting classic 0.10 by 0.015, cornice cove 0.08 by 0.08, casing bevel 0.07 by 0.018, sill rounded 0.03 by 0.04, railing round 0.05 by 0.05, railing_height 0.9.

variation.description: The seed of the build's variation. Seed 0 builds the plan as marked.
